# phux

> Builder entry points checked into this repository at docs/llms.txt.
> https://docs.phux.sh/llms.txt is a different file, maintained in
> no-phux/website at public/llms.txt. This repository does not generate
> that hosted file. https://docs.phux.sh/llms-full.txt is every hosted page.

Start with [Build on phux](./building.md).

## Entry points

- [Build on phux](./building.md): the hub for the surfaces below, the
  version rules, and what this repository does not ship.
- [Versioned `--json`](./scripting.md#json-output-and-errors). The generated
  command text is the [CLI reference](./reference/cli.md).
- [MCP](./agents.md#mcp). `phux mcp` over stdio. The
  [parity table](./reference/parity.md) is generated from the tool catalog.
- [`phux watch`](./scripting.md#watching-events). `--json` is one JSON object
  per line. `--after` resumes from the cursor printed last on stderr.
- [Wire protocol](./protocol.md). Binary frames.
  [Compatibility](./compatibility.md) is the 1.x rule.
  [`wire-schema.json`](./spec/wire-schema.json) is generated from the codec.
- [OSC 7501](./program-protocol.md). One escape sequence, no phux library.
- [Plugins](./plugins.md). A `phux-plugin.toml` manifest.
- [Agent integrations](./agents.md#agent-setup). Includes Claude Code, pi,
  Oh My Pi, OpenCode, Grok, and any MCP client.
- [Calling phux from a program](./agent-quickstart.md#call-phux-from-a-program)
  and [embedding](./embedding.md).

## Agent state

Agent state is evidence-ranked; screen is the floor. It has not been
measured on a live Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode session. The evidence
order is on [Build on phux](./building.md).

## Not shipped

There is no public SDK.
There is no JSON socket.
There is no example application.
There is no plugin index.
Sources for each sentence are on [Build on phux](./building.md).
